reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Virginia
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: When a tenant appeals, is the execution of eviction stayed
    for the duration of the pending appeal?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% STATUTE TRANSLATION (VA Code  8.01-129 (2021))
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% VA Code  8.01-129(A): appeal period is 10 days.
statute_va_801_129_appeal_period_days(10).

% VA Code  8.01-129(B): in unlawful detainer with judgment for possession,
% upon plaintiff request judge orders writ of eviction issue immediately.
statute_va_801_129_writ_may_issue_immediately_if_requested(unlawful_detainer).

% VA Code  8.01-129(B): sheriff may not evict before expiration of 10-day appeal period.
statute_va_801_129_no_eviction_before_appeal_period_expires.

% VA Code  8.01-129(B): if defendant perfects an appeal, sheriff shall return the writ to the clerk.
statute_va_801_129_return_writ_if_defendant_perfects_appeal.

% Legal effect modeled from  8.01-129(B):
% If the writ is returned because the defendant perfected an appeal, then the sheriff
% cannot execute that writ while the appeal is pending (i.e., execution is stayed).
legal_eviction_execution_stayed_during_pending_appeal(Case) :-
    case_type(Case, unlawful_detainer),
    judgment_for_possession_entered(Case, yes),
    appeal_perfected_by_defendant(Case, yes),
    appeal_pending(Case, yes),
    statute_va_801_129_return_writ_if_defendant_perfects_appeal,
    !.

% If the appeal is not pending or not perfected, we do not treat the statute as creating
% a stay for the duration of a pending appeal (because there is no pending perfected appeal).
legal_eviction_execution_stayed_during_pending_appeal(_Case) :-
    !,
    fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% SCENARIO FACTS (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Scenario context
scenario_state(virginia).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% A single case instance for this question.
scenario_case(case1).

% Facts reflecting the question: "When a tenant appeals ..."
% We model the tenant as the defendant in an unlawful detainer eviction case.
case_type(case1, unlawful_detainer).
judgment_for_possession_entered(case1, yes).

% The tenant (defendant) appeals and the appeal is pending.
appeal_perfected_by_defendant(case1, yes).
appeal_pending(case1, yes).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(virginia),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case(Case),
    case_type(Case, unlawful_detainer),
    judgment_for_possession_entered(Case, yes),
    appeal_perfected_by_defendant(Case, yes),
    appeal_pending(Case, yes),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% APPLY REASONING TO ANSWER THE QUESTION
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Question mapped to: is execution of eviction stayed for the duration of the pending appeal?
scenario_eviction_execution_stayed_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_case(Case),
    legal_eviction_execution_stayed_during_pending_appeal(Case),
    !.
scenario_eviction_execution_stayed_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_eviction_execution_stayed_answer(Result),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% MAIN ENTRYPOINT (REQUIRED)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: When a tenant appeals, is the execution of eviction stayed for the duration of the pending appeal?
